stepTitle: Remove the intercept from this model.
stepBody:
Malavikha trains the model
$$\hat{y}=\hat{	heta}_0+\hat{	heta}_1x_1**{2}+\hat{	heta}_{2}\sqrt{x_2}$$
where $$y$$ is attendance rate, $$x_1$$ is dist from bell and $$x_2$$ is section no.
She trains without regularization. After applying bootstrapping, she observes a high model bias squared.
Can the above suggestion reduce model bias squared?
